name: Paula Gallucci Zurita
title: Software Engineer
tagline: Software engineer working on networked systems: backend services, messaging, and the infrastructure in between.
bio: I build backend services and the tooling around them, with a soft spot for anything that has to talk over a network. Alongside engineering work, I teach computer networks at the Universitat de Lleida, where I also build lab tools that let students configure switches and VLANs hands-on.
